purpose: Small reproducibility pilot for 21-residue HybriDock candidates; not a binding validation study.

backend.required_checkpoint_reason: All pilot sequences are 21 residues and the backend threshold is 13 residues.
backend.site_sampling_note: --site does not constrain initial Stage 1 RAPiDock sampling; independent off-pocket and pose-geometry checks remain required.

resource_limits.determinism_qualification: backend documents deterministic sampling modulo CUDA nondeterminism

predeclared_success_criteria: Strict backend preflight passes with executable, dependency environment, argument support, receptor mapping, and longer_local.pt verified.
Every run completes without timeout and emits the expected metadata and pose files.

Every pose selected for target-aware evidence has exact sequence agreement, valid coordinates, an unambiguous peptide chain, no severe clashes, a comparable receptor frame, and at least one independently measured ARG203/ARG205 contact.
Any run failing an evidence gate remains descriptive-only and is not eligible for target-aware ranking.

analysis_plan.primary_comparison: candidate arm versus control arm using predeclared descriptive pose/contact summaries
analysis_plan.sequence_only_baseline: retain the existing sequence-only ranking as a separate analysis arm
analysis_plan.target_aware_selection: use only evidence-gated structural records; docking score alone is descriptive
